protocol.rate_units: fraction; null for an undefined denominator

protocol.normalized: NFC lowercase, ё→е, non-letter/non-number characters become spaces; CER removes spaces
protocol.punctuation: micro F1 for . , ? ! — : anchored to preceding equal lexical token after normalized alignment; BEGIN anchor before first token; substitutions/insertions do not match anchors
protocol.initial_case: first cased letter of each reference segment, aligned by normalized lexical word; unmatched initials count incorrect; conditional_accuracy excludes unmatched
protocol.der: full recording [0,duration_ms], overlap included, optimal global speaker permutation reoptimized after collar exclusion; collar total width ±half around each reference boundary
protocol.cpwer: minimum sum of Levenshtein costs over speaker-concatenated streams, padded empty streams for unequal counts; raw and normalized
protocol.timing: global one-to-one maximum-total temporal IoU matching of positive-duration segments; only positive-IoU pairs; text/speaker independent; granularity-dependent

scope: One completed physical ARM/API37/4KiB automatic0->4 sequential related-repeat 1/3/10-minute group. installed_apk_hash_scope: Actual installed app/test SHA before group and root separate sanitized post-group receipt both match local pinned APKs; all seven actual model SHA are checked by driver both before and after. No additional ADB by auditor.

root_post_group_preservation_receipt.scope: Root receipt verified/pinned; private user database not read by this auditor.
